cards.text: Jesus and His disciples just left Jericho, where a blind beggar named Bartimaeus received his sight (Mark 10:52). Now they're getting close to Jerusalem, and they come to Bethphage and Bethany at the Mount of Olives. Right there, Jesus sends two of His disciples out on an errand.

cards.question: Jesus tells the two disciples to go into the village ahead of them. What does He say they'll find tied there as soon as they walk in?
True or false: Jesus tells the two disciples that no one has ever sat on this colt.

cards.text: They're to untie it and bring it right back. And Jesus even hands them a line to use in case anybody asks what they're doing.

cards.question: If someone asks the two disciples why they're taking the colt, what does Jesus tell them to say?

answers.text: The Lord needs it and will return it shortly
The Teacher will pay you back for it tonight
The priests have sent us here to collect it

cards.text: So off they go, and there's the colt, out in the street, tied at a doorway, just like Jesus said. You could tell ME the sprinkles are on the top shelf, and I'd STILL check the oven, the sink and my own hat first.

They start untying it, and some people standing there ask, "Why are you untying the colt?" Two guys, a colt that isn't theirs, and an audience… that's the moment your heart drops right into your apron.

cards.question: True or false: When the disciples answer the way Jesus told them to, the people standing there refuse to let them take the colt.
True or false: Once the disciples bring the colt to Jesus, He sits on it.

cards.text: Jesus is on the colt now, sitting on the cloaks His disciples threw over it, and the crowd goes ALL in. When I walk into a room, friend, the most I get is somebody asking if the cookies are done.
Many in the crowd spread their cloaks on the road. That's a red carpet, friend, made out of the clothes off their backs.

cards.question: Other people in the crowd cut ___ from the fields and spread them on the road.

cards.text: Front of the line, back of the line, they're BOTH shouting: "Hosanna!" "Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord!"

cards.question: The crowd keeps shouting, and now they call out a blessing on the coming kingdom of their father ___.

cards.text: One more "Hosanna in the highest!" from the crowd. And then Jesus enters Jerusalem.

cards.question: True or false: Once Jesus is inside Jerusalem, He goes into the temple courts.

cards.text: In the temple courts, Jesus looks around at everything.

cards.question: Jesus has looked around the temple courts, and it's already late. What does He do?

answers.text: Goes out to Bethany with the Twelve
Stays the night in the temple courts
Heads back to Jericho with the crowd
